CGLP.description: General Link Property Change (CGLP). Reassigns the property (and optional boundary group) of an existing General Link identified by GLINK_KEY; the record key is the General Link number.

GLINK_KEY.description: General Link number (ID) whose property is being changed. Must reference an existing General Link; the handler forces this to the record key, so it must match the id key of the entry.

CHANGE_PROPERTY_NAME.description: Name of the General Link Property (NLLP) to assign. Must match an existing General Link Property name, otherwise the request is rejected as an invalid name.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary Group name (BNGR) to assign the General Link to. Empty string means no boundary group; any non-empty value must match an existing boundary group name, otherwise the request is rejected as an invalid name.
